Priya (PM): Heads-up — noticed an inconsistency between the help flyout and the main docs when poking the Console today. The flyout uses 'model variant' while our docs use 'model version'. Confusing for customers. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/serving/terminology#models Maya (Design): ugh, good catch. I think we intended 'variant' in UI because it maps to runtime choice, but docs writers landed on 'version' earlier. We should pick one and cross-link, not duplicate terms. Sam (Frontend): FYI the flyout is a sidecar component implemented in ./ui/components/HelpFlyout — there are a couple of strings in code: `title: 'Model variant'` and `subtitle: 'Select the runtime variant to serve'`. Easy to change but need a decision on canonical term. Oliver (Docs): We originally used 'version' to match model registry naming. If we switch UI to 'version' we should also add an inline tooltip explaining the difference between model registry versions and runtime variants (if any). Also recommend adding a doc anchor so Console links to a specific section: `#model-terminology`. Priya (PM): Proposal: use 'Model variant' in UI, keep 'model version' in registry docs, but add consistent cross-links and one-line clarifying phrase in the flyout: "Model variant (runtime selection; see docs)". That keeps UI actionable. Thoughts? Maya (Design): That works visually. One tweak: make the parenthetical copy shorter for small screens. Suggested copy: `Model variant — runtime selection. Learn more` with a small chevron that opens the doc panel. Sam (Frontend): Accessibility note: current flyout focus order is broken — tabbing sometimes escapes into background and VoiceOver doesn't announce the close button. We should fix focus trap + add `aria-label` on the close button. Quick patch idea: ```
``` Will add to PR if we decide copy. design-bot: lint warning on copy length in mobile: `help_flyout.title` > 24 chars flagged. Consider shorter label or overflow style. Jordan (Eng): Also add instrumentation: link clicks from flyout -> doc anchor + telemetry so we can measure if users actually use the cross-link. Tag event `help_flyout.doc_click` with `term:variant_or_version`. Oliver (Docs): I'll add a short section `Model terms` with plain examples and a one-sentence canonical definition. Then will publish and give y'all the anchor. Priya (PM): Action items summarised: 1) Docs: Oliver to add anchor + canonical one-liner, 2) Design: Maya to finalize microcopy (variant vs version parenthetical), 3) Frontend: Sam to implement copy + focus trap + aria label, 4) Eng: Jordan to add telemetry. Can we aim for a small design review tomorrow? Maya (Design): I'll post two microcopy options in #design-review before EOD and include visual for mobile. Option A = `Model variant — runtime selection. Learn more` ; Option B = `Model version (runtime) · Learn more` Sam (Frontend): I'll spin up a tiny PR (no UX changes besides copy + a11y fixes). Will reference this thread and do feature-flag rollout. Expect PR link by EOD: #4321. Priya (PM): Thanks — if we all agree, I'll update the release notes checklist to include the docs cross-link requirement for small copy changes like this. Oliver (Docs): Done — created doc stub at /serving/terminology#model-terms. Will ping when published. Priya (PM): Cool. Quick reminder: please add screen-reader-friendly text for the inline link (avoid 'learn more' as only label). Example: `aria-label="Learn more about model variants (opens docs)"`. Sam (Frontend): noted and will implement. Maya (Design): I'll also add a focus-visible style for the flyout controls so keyboard users can see where they are. Priya (PM): Awesome. Closing loop: let's reconvene after PR & docs are live for a 10-min ship-check in #product. :thumbsup:
